# Made in USA Walk-In Tubs

> Consumer guide to walk-in bathtubs made in the United States: what "Made in USA" legally means under the FTC standard and 16 CFR Part 323, which walk-in tub makers publish U.S. manufacturing statements (quoted from their own sites, checked October 15, 2026), questions to ask a dealer, warranty and parts considerations, and Buy American rules for VA and government buyers.

Published by Aging Safely Baths (https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/), a walk-in tub dealer and installer that sells Meditub, Bestbath (RANE), Hydro Dimensions and Ella's Bubbles. Phone 1-888-779-2284. Quotes and installation requests: https://www.agingsafelybaths.com/made-in-usa-walk-in-tubs/

Facts policy: manufacturer statements are quoted from each maker's own website with the date checked. No prices, ratings or reviews are published on this site.

## Guides
- [Made in USA walk-in tubs, explained and checked](https://madeinusawalkintubs.com/): What a Made in USA walk-in tub label legally means, which makers say they build in the U.S. and where, and what to ask about warranties and parts.
- [What "Made in USA" legally means on a walk-in tub](https://madeinusawalkintubs.com/made-in-usa-label-rules/): The FTC all or virtually all standard and 16 CFR 323 explained for walk-in tubs, plus what assembled in USA, designed in USA and qualified claims mean.
- [Walk-in tub manufacturers that say they build in the USA](https://madeinusawalkintubs.com/us-walk-in-tub-manufacturers/): Eight walk-in tub makers that publish U.S. manufacturing statements, with each one's exact wording, location named, warranty notes and a dated source link.
- [Questions to ask a dealer before you buy an American-made walk-in tub](https://madeinusawalkintubs.com/dealer-questions/): A checklist of questions to ask a walk-in tub dealer about where a tub is made, its parts, the warranty, the installer and the paperwork before you sign.
- [Walk-in tub warranties and parts: read the terms, not the badge](https://madeinusawalkintubs.com/warranty-and-parts/): What walk-in tub warranties from U.S. makers actually cover, common exclusions that void coverage, and how to check replacement parts will still be available.
- [Buy American rules, VA purchases and walk-in tubs](https://madeinusawalkintubs.com/buy-american-va-government/): How the federal Buy American statute and FAR Part 25 differ from the FTC Made in USA label, and what veterans using a VA HISA grant should know.

## Key facts
- Unqualified "Made in USA" (including "built", "manufactured", "crafted" in USA) means all or virtually all U.S. content and processing, with final assembly in the U.S. (FTC; 16 CFR 323.1 and 323.2, effective August 13, 2021).
- "Assembled in USA" means principal, substantial assembly and last substantial transformation in the U.S.; parts may be imported.
- The FTC does not pre-approve or certify origin claims.
- Federal Buy American purchasing (FAR Part 25): manufactured in the U.S. with domestic component cost above 65% (deliveries 2024-2028) and 75% (2029 onward); COTS items have the component test waived.
- VA HISA application rule (38 CFR 17.3120) contains no domestic-content requirement.
